capture_viewer.keyboard: D610 read/ack only after timers stopped; no gameplay input service

cia_timing.units: raw CIA counts; SI calibration and physical identity pending
cia_timing.exit: timers stopped; nonreturning; reset required; no inherited timer-state restoration
cia_timing.irq: masked throughout standalone run; no IRQ measurement or service claim

clock.notes: unpaced functional iterations; no measured or scheduled 100 Hz clock

calibration.conversion: none; raw low-byte differences cannot establish elapsed time
calibration.full_measurement_gate: Requires an admitted timebase, calibrated units, wrap resolution, independent simulation/display clocks and attributed physical platform evidence. These are not supplied by this proxy.

acquisition.phase_wait_failure_rule: validity bit clear when requested raster low-byte is not observed before timeout

sample_units.interpretation: raw modulo-256 sample bytes only; no cycle-time conversion or wrap-unwrapping
sample_units.ordering: case-major payload; sample index 0..15 requests low-byte value index*16 within each case; cross-case execution order is unspecified by the C expression

wrap_handling.percentiles: do not represent elapsed-time percentile/worst timing values

result_encoding.header: 0:3 ASCII R0F1; 4 revision; 5 nominal model Hz; 6 stages; 7 functional status
result_encoding.timing_payload: 160:239 five cases x 16 raw sample bytes

failure_behavior.acquisition_failure: on timeout, clear that sample's validity bit and keep timing status byte 151 at 0
failure_behavior.case_failures: functional case counters remain deterministic; acquisition pass byte expresses timing completeness only
failure_behavior.false_pass_rejection: host validator rejects altered fixed fields even after recomputing a valid checksum; separately rejects checksum corruption and wrong lengths

linked_startup_review.observation: Retained PRG startup executes SEI and writes $00/$01/$D030; establishes B=$02 at $2025-$2027; .init.250 calls KERNAL $FFD2 at $2035 before main, with no B=$00 thunk in that path.
linked_startup_review.authority: docs/decisions/R0-A-45GS02-B-REGISTER-INTEGRATION.md requires a separately proved B-save/B=$00/B-restore thunk for KERNAL calls.
linked_startup_review.disposition: R0-F-only startup.ld excludes the pinned SDK char-conv .init.250 initializer because this proof writes screen codes directly and uses no SDK text I/O. Audit rejects linked direct ROM calls/jumps. No ROM wrapper is added; stock startup/base-page sequence is retained. New carrier F65R0F2.D81 requires fresh evidence.

platform_register_access.source: LLVM-MOS MEGA65 VIC-II-compatible rasterline accessor in mega65.h

timing_behavior.failure_path: validity bit clear; status byte 151 becomes 0
timing_behavior.determinism: bounded loop bound is deterministic; match start phase can drift under contention, so sampling is phase-targeted only

architecture_contract_alignment: no MAP/IRQ/NMI registration in this helper
no kernel calls, callbacks, scheduler yields, or storage calls
no handwritten assembly added for this helper
startup establishes B=$02 after stock ROM startup; fini would restore B=$00, but main does not return
ROM-hosted MAP/IRQ state is inherited and is not a production canonical MemoryAccessABI proof
platform_architecture_review.register_clobber_scope: Ordinary compiled C under the pinned LLVM-MOS ABI, not preserve-all; generated instructions and compiler pseudo-register use require build-specific inspection. No new Q preservation contract or handwritten wrapper is admitted.

memory_ownership.scope: whole standalone proof; the raster helper itself only reads D012 and uses compiler temporaries/stack
writes: 192-byte snapshot BSS; current address in generated map
107-byte compiler static stack .noinit; current address in generated map
compiler base page $0200-$02FF and stack usage; dynamic high-water unknown
stock startup writes $00/$01/$D030 before main; unnecessary SDK ROM initializer excluded

failure_classification.acquisition_not_observed: does not alter functional counters; timing-only pass bit is lowered
failure_classification.hardware_identity_missing: diagnostic observations remain attributable only to their recorded evidence tier; full hardware measurement acceptance is blocked

encoding.0:7: ASCII R0F1, revision 1, model Hz, stages, functional status 127=pass
encoding.8:27: five little-endian u32 profile labels: 9, 16, 24, 48, 64; metadata, not actual entity execution
encoding.28:32: snapshot count 3, record bytes 64, proxy marker 1, reserved 0, case count 5
encoding.64:143: five 16-byte functional records inherited from R0-E; last two bytes reserved zero
encoding.144:159: RT observation header; +7 acquisition status 127=complete, not timing pass
encoding.160:239: five cases x 16 modulo-256 raster deltas in requested phase order (phase index x 16)
encoding.240:249: five little-endian u16 validity masks; bit index matches sample index

limitations: Unpaced 21-stage functional model, not real 100Hz scheduling
Synthetic input/audio and fault counters, not hardware service or overflow proof
Phase acquisition is bounded to 65535 reads; sampled start can lag requested phase
Modulo-256 wraps unresolved; no elapsed-time ordering, cycles or latency
Synchronous snapshot proxy, not concurrency proof
DMA and IRQ measurement not executed
Physical platform identity requires external capture
abi: LLVM-MOS pinned C ABI; private raster helper reads D012 only; inherited R0-A startup sets B=02 and fini B=00; no new assembly
canonical_state: ROM-hosted standalone proof; no claim that stock ROM MAP/IRQ context satisfies production canonical MemoryAccessABI
storage: No storage call after program entry
